## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Tokens & Theme Design

**Figma frame:** _Tokens & Theme Design_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Foundation for:** UI-01 through UI-20.

### Context

Frame showing color palette, gradients, background surfaces, typography scale, and spacing rules used across the demo.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Dark-mode color palette, semantic color roles, gradients, and background surfaces.
- Typography scale and text roles, including contrast guidance.
- Spacing scale and named styles or variables for use by all other frames.

### Deliverables

- Published token styles or variables and a reference frame documenting their usage.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Color, gradient, surface, typography, and spacing systems are documented
- [ ] Semantic names are used instead of loose values
- [ ] Text and interactive states meet dark-mode contrast requirements
- [ ] Tokens are published and reusable by UI-01 through UI-20
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Define reusable design-system styles or variables; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
